test_title: PYST 18: SSC CGL 2022 - English (Held On: 06 Dec 2022 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Identify the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the given sentence.**

The game __continued __due to heavy rainfall after the pitch became completely wet.
solution: The correct answer is: **Stopped** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • **Continued**: Lasting or extending without interruption. (बिना किसी रुकावट के स्थायी या विस्तारित) • Let us look at the **meaning **of the words given in the options section. • **Ongoing**: Continuing to exist, happen, or develop. (अस्तित्व में रहना, घटित होना या विकसित होना) • **Played**: Engage in activity for enjoyment and recreation rather than a serious or practical purpose. (एक गंभीर या व्यावहारिक उद्देश्य के बजाय आनंद और मनोरंजन के लिए गतिविधि में संलग्न हों) • **Stopped**: To cause an action, process, or event to come to an end. (किसी क्रिया, प्रक्रिया या घटना को समाप्त करने के लिए) • **Disregarded**: Lack of consideration or respect. (विचार या सम्मान की कमी) • From the meaning of the given words, it is clear that the most appropriate antonym of '**continued**' is '**stopped**'. • Therefore, the correct answer is option 3. 30:T649, The correct answer is: **To be alert**
